SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over () AS row_num , temp.* FROM (SELECT b.book_name_ko , b.book_code_ko , a.chapter , a.verse , a.content FROM bible_verses a JOIN bible_info b ON a.book_id = b.id WHERE b.testament IN ('OLD', 'NEW') ORDER BY rand() LIMIT 20) temp
